summary: # Clo 2024.1 新機能ウェビナー ## はじめに Hello everyone, this is the BlackJapan team. In this video, we will introduce the new features and functional improvements of the 2024.1 version. In addition, in today's webinar, we will ask questions in real time. If you have any questions, please feel free to ask them in the YouTube chat section. In addition, in order to use the chat, you will need to log in to YouTube. Please let us know if you have any questions. ## ウェビナーの内容 In this webinar, we will proceed with the key features, UI, 2D, avatar, 3D, material, mode, rendering, and cross-set items. Archive videos will also be released after the webinar, so please take a look. ## AI Avatar Studio In the 2024.1 version, the AI Avatar Studio feature was added. The AI Avatar Studio will be able to create a photo-realistic wear image by naturally synthesizing and compiling a costume image and AI in the black rendering, or a photo of your hand, and creating a photo-realistic wear image. This is the image that was actually created. Light and shadow are calculated accurately, and the skin tone of the entire body is naturally harmonized, not only the face. ### AI Avatar Studioの使用方法 1. Click on the AI Avatar Studio from the rendering tab in the main menu. 2. Two points are required to use the AI Avatar Studio: - A face photo of the actual person. - A target rendered with an avatar and a 3D costume. ### 画像の準備 Now let's prepare the target image. Read the project file containing the costume and the avatar. Next, to render the costume, click on Rendering from the main menu and open the Rendering window. First, check the recommended settings for rendering. By rendering based on the recommended settings, the avatar face can be naturally synthesized. ### 推奨設定の確認 Here is a magic trick. Click on the icon at the top. As you can see, the AI Avatar Studio window opens. In the left column, you can check the necessary conditions for creating a target image: 1. Set the rendering image size to 2160 pixels or more, or 4320 pixels or less. The image size should be larger than 2160 pixels to avoid software errors. 2. The avatar and background must be clearly distinguished. If the avatar is not correctly recognized by lighting and shadows, the result may be unnatural. Use images that can distinguish the face, hair, and costume of the avatar. ### 画像の最終レンダリング Once you have confirmed that the image is set based on the recommended plan, click on the final rendering to generate an image with high resolution. Once the target image has been rendered, please click the AI Avatar Studio icon again. You will see that the rendered image is automatically uploaded. ## フェイス画像の作成 On the left side, you can create an image with the face. First of all, ensure that the front tab is selected. In the menu at the bottom left of the head photo column, you will be able to check the recommended information about creating reference images and faces. The recommended information is: - The image should be a closed front. - The face image should not be hidden by hair or shadow. ### フェイス画像の生成 Let's create a face image based on these recommended facts. First, select the gender and age of the face to be generated from the option menu. For skin tone, set it to approach the target image for a more natural final result. In the Text Prompt window, you can enter the characteristics of the face you want to generate with keywords. Once the setting is complete, click the Create button to generate an image. ### ランダム機能の活用 There are times when waiting times occur depending on the number of people using the server at the same time. The content of the image will change, so it is recommended to use it in several different ways. The random function is useful if you want an idea for a keyword. For gender, age, and gender options, click on the Text Prompt button. ### 生成された画像の履歴確認 If you click on the History tab on the right, the window will expand, and you can check the images generated in the past. Double-click on the image to read the record of the image, options, and text prompt. The record is maintained until black is completed, and when black is completed, the record will be deleted. ## PBRマップジェネレーター Next, I would like to introduce the PBR Map Generator. The PBR map is an essential element to make 3D textures real. In black, you can use textures, normal maps, displacement maps, opacity maps, roughness maps, and metalness maps. ### PBRマップの自動生成 In the previous version, it was necessary to use external software such as black and Photoshop to prepare and edit the PBR map. However, in this update, we have released a feature that automatically generates PBR maps in black without using external software. All you need to prepare is a texture image. ### テクスチャの追加 Select the article and check the material information from the attribute edit. When the texture is added, the PBR map generator button will be displayed. When you click the PBR map generator, the texture image will be displayed as a text image. The PBR map is automatically generated within 1 second based on the texture image. ## グラフィック素材の作成 The graphic material creation reset has been added from the 2024.1 version. Open the costume file where the graphics are applied to the pattern of the front and back. First, open the new material added to the graphic of the front and back. ### 新しい印刷タイプの適用 Select the graphic transformation tool and click on the graphic of the front and back. The graphic item applied to the front and back in the object browser is highlighted in blue, and the applied graphic can be checked. The material of the attribute editing shows that the current print type is set to digital DTG. You can now express various graphic materials from this version. ## アバター編集機能の更新 The avatar editing function has been updated from the 2024.1 version, allowing you to edit specific parts, including the bust and crotch of the avatar. The new avatar will be displayed under the name V2. Live V2 for adult avatars and V1 for child avatars. ### アバターのサイズと形状 The new avatar editing is largely divided into the categories of size and shape. The size category includes size input columns and size preset unit options. The UI has been improved to allow for easier selection and deletion of size items. ### ロック機能の追加 A lock function has been added so that each size can be adjusted individually. The lock function is displayed on the icon on the upper right of the width and height items. ## 色編集機能のアップデート In CRO2024.1, the color scheme can be freely combined and easily applied. The structure of the main menu has been updated, and the position of the color editor has been changed. Click on the production button from the menu bar and click on the color scheme in the drop-down menu to open the color editor. ### カラーバリエーションの設定 The materials used in the current 3D costume will be displayed for each item. Here you can create a color scheme individually for each item. The new color scheme that has been added is based on the color scheme option setting selected by the color scheme editor. ## 自動モジュラーラベリング In the 2024.1 version, modular automatic labeling was added to the modular library. This function automatically identifies each pattern with AI based on the automatic layout information of the modular. ### モジュラー機能の使用方法 There are two ways to use the automatic modular function. The first method involves selecting the group and double-clicking on the category item to activate the modular automatic labeling. ## 終わりに Thank you for your attention. The update has made it possible to create various colors more efficiently. Please try the color editing editor that has improved its functions. We look forward to seeing you in the next version webinar.
